content_of_post_to_comment:
For me, it was writing down the next physical action before I stopped working.

Not the whole plan, just the first thing I need to do when I come back. It makes restarting feel much less annoying.

What’s one small thing that genuinely made your workday easier?
comment: I started doing something similar with unfinished tasks, but I also leave a quick note about why I stopped. The next session is easier because I’m not just seeing the action, I remember the context behind it. It turns the restart from a mental reset into a continuation. Curious if your method also helps with avoiding that first few minutes of figuring out where you left off.
